scope: Independent manual full reading of 39 exposed-DEV outputs only; fixed R46 Python diagnostic, no model rerun or TF metrics inspected.

definitions.naturalWhole: Entire continuation linguistically natural and semantically coherent; evaluated separately from contextual fit.
definitions.contextRelevant: Whole reply fits supplied prefix; mere topic-word overlap is insufficient, empty context is null.
definitions.genericOnly: Only generic social/query/formulaic material, with no established grounded specific content; may itself be malformed.
definitions.onsets: 0-based Unicode character offsets in unchanged continuation; null means absent or exact onset uncertain. No gold departure is treated as quality failure.
